heading: Atypical path? I'd say well typed.

law.title: Lawyer in Brazil
law.text: Nearly five years in labor and business law, across firms and public institutions.

france.title: Moving to France
france.text: Master's in Human Rights Law at the University of Strasbourg. A new chapter begins.

firstCode.title: First steps in code
firstCode.text: Intensive web bootcamp. Discovering development and confirming a career pivot.

cda.title: Full Stack CDA Training
cda.text: 10 intensive months at O'Clock, then a startup internship (InnovQube). The full stack breakthrough.

mainframe.title: Mainframe POEI
mainframe.text: COBOL, DB2, JCL, z/OS specialization at M2i. Entering the world of legacy systems.

now.title: Mainframe Consultant & Jurema
now.text: Mission-critical banking & insurance systems. In parallel, custom web projects through Jurema, my freelance practice.

approach.title: approach
approach.text: I see every new programming language as an opportunity, not a barrier. From TypeScript to COBOL — every environment has its own logic, and I adapt. My work is driven by rigor, clean code, and a deep understanding of the business context.

beyondCode.title: beyond code
beyondCode.text: Outside of development, I love cinema, running, dogs, and cooking. These passions keep me balanced and continuously inspired.
